11.landmark: Keyboard Field, the large clearing at the initial

17.landmark: Clearing to the right of the dirt road network

29.landmark: Pond with trees at the initial; homestead on a road roughly perpendicular to RWY 29 ahead

35.landmark: Gravel pit on the left, Berclair on the right (do not overfly)

info.title: Goliad at a glance
instructions: Goliad RDO · UHF CH 15 · Goliad CTAF · VHF CH 15
Goliad ASOS · UHF CH 14
Open Mon–Fri from 0800 until the RDO departs; closes upon departure of the RDO
Break 1,300' · Pattern 1,100'
High key 2,800–3,300' · Low key 1,800' · Delta 2,300'
Max 5 in the pattern (the RDO may reduce it)
Goliad is the only OLF open to solos; practice ELPs are not authorized with solos in or inbound to the pattern
Lost comms: aircraft established in the pattern may full-stop at the Aircraft Commander's discretion

info.title: Arrival entry options
instructions: Arrivals may enter via the break or a PPEL

info.title: Pattern direction and ELPs (Goofy Goliad)
instructions: Pattern side: RWY 11/29 north · RWY 17/35 west
Pattern PPELs (PPEL/P) go the PATTERN direction
Full ELPs go OPPOSITE of the landing pattern
ELP means traffic entering the OLF on an ELP profile, whether a PPEL or a simulated power loss
PPEL/P means traffic established in the pattern proceeding to pattern low key
Practice ELPs are not authorized with solos in the pattern or inbound to it. PPEL/Ps are permitted with solos in the pattern

info.title: Pattern full
instructions: The RDO will advise if the pattern is full and of any traffic holding at the initial or at high key
Solos shall not hold
Stack at the appropriate initial with right-hand turns at 1,500', 2,500', 3,500', 4,500', etc.
Avoid overflying the town of Berclair due to noise complaints

info.title: Discontinued entry
instructions: RDO directs it
RDO has not acknowledged your initial call by 2 NM
You are lined up on the wrong runway
PPEL/P not in sight by 2 NM, or a conflict
Past the upwind numbers and interval is in doubt
Outside 2 NM: turn 90° or more away from the pattern, hold 1,300' until clear
Inside 2 NM: hold 1,300' and depart beyond the upwind numbers, clear of traffic
